description: This file defines the DataWriter interface used in Spark SQL connector for writing data partitions, including methods for writing, committing, aborting, and resource cleanup, along with detailed documentation on its lifecycle and retry mechanisms.

classes.name: DataWriter
classes.description: An interface for writing data in Spark SQL connector, responsible for writing records, committing, aborting, and resource cleanup, with support for metrics and lifecycle management.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a single record; can also include metadata if needed.

methods.name: writeAll
methods.description: Default method to write all records from an iterator.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Finalizes writing and returns a commit message for the driver.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts the writing process and cleans up resources.

methods.name: currentMetricsValues
methods.description: Returns current task metrics; default implementation returns an empty array.
